questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Phnom Penh?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Cambodia is Phnom Penh.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Cambodia?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Culture” part of the Cambodia article.

questions.proof: Cambodians are famous for a type of 'kah-tieu' called 'kah-tieu Phnom Penh' which has shrimp, beef balls, fried garlic, pork broth and chicken.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Cambodia?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Cambodia on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Foreign relations” part of the Cambodia article.

questions.proof: Cambodia has border issues with Vietnam and Thailand over lost territories.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Cambodia about 181,035 square kilometres; Tajikistan about 143,100 square kilometres; South Korea about 100,295 square kilometres; Taiwan about 36,197 square kilometres.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Cambodia on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Cambodia on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
